blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The municipality of Taytay, Rizal, continued to experience dangerous heat after recording a heat index of 43.9 degrees Celsius on Friday morning. The municipal government’s Public Information Office (PIO) said in an advisory that the reading was recorded at 9 a.m. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) classifies heat index readings into four categories: Caution (27°C to 32°C), Extreme Caution (33°C to 41°C), Danger (42°C to 51°C), and Extreme Danger (52°C and above).
